$Comment: New Year's Eve, December 31st (both ends that one day, counted in UTC), inside Christmas. The file name
is the event id. It exists so content can wait for the day itself: MMO Skill Tree's boost rule
the boost runs only while both are live. It has no Herald, so it comes and goes without a banner.
It is an event of its own, on its own dates: a server owner who moves Christmas in
mods/ziggfreedcommon/calendar.json moves this one there too. Switching Christmas off is enough to keep
the boost out, since the boost reads Christmas as well. /zigcalendar status Christmas_New_Years_Eve shows
